member_attestation_complete.name: member_attestation_complete
member_attestation_complete.value: "member"."verification_method" <> 'organiser_attestation' or ("member"."attested_by_id" is not null and "member"."attested_at" is not null)

submission_proposal_fields.name: submission_proposal_fields
submission_proposal_fields.value: "submission"."type" <> 'proposal' or ("submission"."cost_band" is not null and "submission"."responsible_authority" is not null)

legal_review_public_note_required.name: legal_review_public_note_required
legal_review_public_note_required.value: "legal_review"."status" not in ('withheld', 'takedown') or "legal_review"."public_note" is not null

commitment_status_reason.name: commitment_status_reason
commitment_status_reason.value: "commitment"."status" not in ('slipped', 'dropped') or "commitment"."status_reason" is not null

session_question_selection_complete.name: session_question_selection_complete
session_question_selection_complete.value: "session_question"."selected" = false or ("session_question"."selected_by_id" is not null and "session_question"."selected_at" is not null)

session_question_written_answer.name: session_question_written_answer
session_question_written_answer.value: "session_question"."outcome" <> 'answered_in_writing' or ("session_question"."answer_text" is not null and "session_question"."answered_by_id" is not null)

outbound_notification_terminal_instants.name: outbound_notification_terminal_instants
outbound_notification_terminal_instants.value:
("outbound_notification"."state" = 'queued' and "outbound_notification"."sent_at" is null and "outbound_notification"."failed_at" is null)
        or ("outbound_notification"."state" = 'sent' and "outbound_notification"."sent_at" is not null and "outbound_notification"."failed_at" is null)
        or ("outbound_notification"."state" = 'failed' and "outbound_notification"."failed_at" is not null and "outbound_notification"."sent_at" is null)

generated.as: setweight(to_tsvector('simple', coalesce("reference", '')), 'A') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple', coalesce("body", '')), 'B') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple', coalesce("location_text", '')), 'C')
